```{r}
#| label: eyetracking-ancova-zscore-data
#| include: false

# import data
eye_raw <- read.csv(
  file = "../extdata/MET_AOI_FOR_ANALYSIS.csv"
)

# restrict data to those with data at baseline and wk 16
eye_data <- eye_raw |>
  dplyr::mutate(
    Count = dplyr::n(),
    .by = ID
  ) |>
  dplyr::filter(
    Count > 1
  ) |>
  # id 18-2-004 has 2 obs for visit 3, remove where screen_lvp = 51.2713902
  dplyr::filter(
    !(ID == "18-2-004" & Entire_Screen_Face_Pct_LvP == 51.2713902)
  ) |>
  dplyr::rename(fxs_sts_id = ID)

# extract id from met_analytic to ensure eye tracking data is only for those
# in our analytic dataset
analytic_ids <- metformin.rct::met_analytic |>
  dplyr::select(Source, fxs_sts_id, rand_code) |>
  unique() |>
  dplyr::mutate(
    id = dplyr::if_else(
      Source == "UCD",
      rand_code,
      fxs_sts_id |> gsub("FXSMET-", "", x = _)
    )
  ) |>
  dplyr::pull(id) |>
  unique()

eye_data <- eye_data |>
  dplyr::filter(fxs_sts_id %in% analytic_ids)

# get subj data from met_analytic (Treatment, age, sex, IQ)
eye_demog <- metformin.rct::met_analytic |>
  dplyr::filter(redcap_event_name == "Baseline Visit (Visit 1)") |>
  dplyr::select(Source, Site, fxs_sts_id, rand_code,
                demo_age, sex, leit3_nv_iq, Molecular.Category, Treatment) |>
  dplyr::mutate(
    ID = dplyr::case_when(
      Source == "UCD" ~ rand_code,
      Source == "Canada" ~ gsub("FXSMET-", "", fxs_sts_id)
    ),
    .after = Source
  ) |>
  dplyr::select(-c(Source, fxs_sts_id, rand_code)) |>
  dplyr::rename(fxs_sts_id = ID)

## analytic data: join demographics and add redcap_event_name and centered variables
eye_ancova_zscore_data <- eye_data |>
  dplyr::left_join(
    x = _,
    y = eye_demog,
    by = "fxs_sts_id"
  ) |>
  dplyr::mutate(
    redcap_event_name = dplyr::case_when(
      Visit == 1 ~ "Baseline Visit (Visit 1)",
      Visit == 2 ~ "Week 8 Visit (Visit 2)",
      Visit == 3 ~ "Week 16 (Visit 3/Early Term)"
    ),
    dplyr::across(
      .cols = c(demo_age, leit3_nv_iq),
      ~ .x - mean(.x, na.rm = TRUE),
      .names = "{.col}_center"
    )
  ) |>
  # Restrict to baseline and week 16 for time-specific z-score computation
  dplyr::filter(Visit %in% c(1, 3)) |>
  # Compute time-specific z-scores within each Visit
  dplyr::group_by(Visit) |>
  dplyr::mutate(
    # Z-score for All_Face_Pct_vP
    All_Face_Pct_vP_z = scale(All_Face_Pct_vP)[, 1],
    # Z-scores for each Emotion x AOI variable
    dplyr::across(
      .cols = c(
        Happy_Eyes_Pct, Calm_Eyes_Pct, Fear_Eyes_Pct,
        Happy_Nose_Pct, Calm_Nose_Pct, Fear_Nose_Pct,
        Happy_Mouth_Pct, Calm_Mouth_Pct, Fear_Mouth_Pct
      ),
      ~ scale(.x)[, 1],
      .names = "{.col}_z"
    )
  ) |>
  dplyr::ungroup() |>
  # Compute composite z-scores (sum of Emotion z-scores per AOI)
  dplyr::mutate(
    Eyes_zscore  = (Happy_Eyes_Pct_z + Calm_Eyes_Pct_z + Fear_Eyes_Pct_z) / 3,
    Nose_zscore  = (Happy_Nose_Pct_z + Calm_Nose_Pct_z + Fear_Nose_Pct_z) / 3,
    Mouth_zscore = (Happy_Mouth_Pct_z + Calm_Mouth_Pct_z + Fear_Mouth_Pct_z) / 3
  )

## define z-score outcomes
eye_zscore_var <- c(
  "All_Face_Pct_vP_z",
  "Eyes_zscore", "Nose_zscore", "Mouth_zscore"
)
eye_zscore_label <- c(
  "Face vP (z-score)",
  "Eyes (composite z-score)", "Nose (composite z-score)", "Mouth (composite z-score)"
)
names(eye_zscore_label) <- eye_zscore_var

# fit adjusted ANCOVA models
eye_ancova_z <- lapply(
  eye_zscore_var,
  function(x) fit_ancova(
    dataset = eye_ancova_zscore_data,
    outcome = x,
    outcome_label = eye_zscore_label[x],
    covariates = NULL
  )
)
names(eye_ancova_z) <- eye_zscore_label

# extract tables from fit_ancova output
eye_ancova_z_summary <- dplyr::bind_rows(
  lapply(
    names(eye_ancova_z),
    function(x) {
      eye_ancova_z[[x]]$tbl
    }
  )
)
```

```{r}
#| label: tbl-eyetracking-ancova-zscore
#| tbl-cap: !expr
#|    glue::glue(
#|    "Eye Tracking Z-score ANCOVA - Adjusted ANCOVA results showing LS means (95% CI) for baseline and
#|    16-week change, and between-group difference in changes. All_Face_Pct_vP is z-scored within each
#|    timepoint. Eyes, Nose, and Mouth outcomes are composite z-scores (mean of Emotion-specific z-scores
#|    within each timepoint). {data_caption}")

eye_ancova_z_ft <- eye_ancova_z_summary |>
  dplyr::select(-contrast_p) |>
  flextable::flextable() |>
  flextable::set_header_labels(
    Outcome = "Outcome",
    n_p = "N",
    baseline_p = "Baseline",
    baseline_p_ci = "95% CI",
    week16_p = "Week 16",
    week16_p_ci = "95% CI",
    p_change = "Change",
    p_change_ci = "95% CI",
    n_m = "N",
    baseline_m = "Baseline",
    baseline_m_ci = "95% CI",
    week16_m = "Week 16",
    week16_m_ci = "95% CI",
    m_change = "Change",
    m_change_ci = "95% CI",
    baseline_contrast_mean = "Baseline Diff",
    baseline_contrast_ci = "95% CI",
    contrast_mean = "Change Diff",
    contrast_ci = "95% CI"
  ) |>
  flextable::add_header_row(
    values = c("", "Placebo", "Metformin", "Between-Group Differences"),
    colwidths = c(1, 7, 7, 4)
  ) |>
  flextable::theme_vanilla() |>
  flextable::align(i = 1, align = "left", part = "header") |>
  flextable::align(i = 2, align = "center", part = "header") |>
  flextable::align(j = 1, align = "left", part = "all") |>
  flextable::vline(j = c(1, 8, 15), part = "all") |>
  flextable::autofit()

eye_ancova_z_ft
```

```{r}
#| label: fig-eyetracking-ancova-zscore-forest
#| fig-cap: !expr
#|    glue::glue(
#|    "Eye Tracking Z-score ANCOVA - Forest plot showing between-group differences in changes. {data_caption}")

eye_ancova_z_list <- lapply(eye_ancova_z, function(x) list("fit" = x$fit$fit))

plot_ancova_forest(
  obj = eye_ancova_z_list,
  labels = eye_zscore_label,
  min_mult = 1.1,
  max_mult = 1.1
)
```
